_comment: CSA Z94.2-14 / CSA Z94.2:18 regulatory values. Confirmed by Norm, industrial audiometric technician, BC (2026-09-29).

dual._note: Uses higher raw NRR of the two devices. Both NRR values are required; the calculator will not estimate with a missing second device.

csa_classes.label: Class B
csa_classes.l_suffix_note: For low-frequency noise (e.g. large diesel engines, compressors), consider an L-rated device (BL).

csa_classes.label: Class A
csa_classes.l_suffix_note: For low-frequency noise (e.g. large diesel engines, compressors), consider an L-rated device (AL).

csa_classes.label: Dual protection required
csa_classes.dual_min_note: Minimum: Class A earplug + Class B earmuff (CSA Z94.2-14 s.9).

adequacy._bands: over-protected: Lprot < 70 dBA (blue); adequate: 70 ≤ Lprot ≤ limit (green); caution: limit < Lprot ≤ limit+3 (yellow); danger: Lprot > limit+3 (red)
adequacy._over_protected_note: Threshold set at 70 dBA per EN 458 guidance. Flagging higher values risks pushing users toward inadequate protection.
